import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static long n, c1, c2, ans, pw[] = new long[20], sum[] = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] buc = new ArrayList[10];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buc[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfs(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buc[i]);
        }
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 12; i++) {
            pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        dfs2(0);
        System.out.println((ans + MOD1) % MOD1);
    }

    static void query(long p, long s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            long x = ((s - p * pw[i]) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
            ans = (ans + x * buc[i].size() + sum[i]) % MOD1;
            int idx = lowerBound(buc[i], MOD2 - x);
            long count = (buc[i].size() - idx);
            ans = (ans - count * MOD2) % MOD1;
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int left = 0, right = list.size();
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }

    static void dfs(long x, int d) {
        long tmp = ((c1++ - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
        sum[d] = (sum[d] + tmp) % MOD1;
        buc[d].add(tmp);
        if (d == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(x * 10 + i, d + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if ((x + 1) * 1000000L <= n + 1 && x * 10000000L > n) {
            query(x, c2);
            c2 += c1;
        } else {
            ans = (ans + ((c2++ - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD1;
            int start = (x != 0) ? 0 : 1;
            for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
                dfs2(x * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }
}
